simple.summary: יְהוֹעַדָּה (Yᵉhôwʻaddâh) means Jehoaddah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 36.

definitions.full: H3085. Yehoaddah יְהוֺעַדָּה proper name, masculine (meaning dubious; Thes ׳י hath adorned (as Hebrew עדה Hiph`il; verb of Pa`el form); MV ׳י is equipment , compare Arabic ; possibly ׳י hath carried off spoil , or hath deposed ( עדא ᵑ7 Pe`al, Pa`el, Aph`el; compare Haph`el Dan 2:21 ); or perhaps ׳י hath numbered Arabic ) — a descendant of Saul 1Chr 8:36 (twice in verse) ( ᵐ5 Ἰωαδα , A Ἰωιαδα , ᵐ5 L Ἰωδα ) = יַעְרָה 9:42 (twice in verse) (for יֹעַדָּה ? compare Be. ᵐ5 Ἰαδα , ᵐ5 L Ἰωδα .
